	-- Duplicate haberleri tespit et (aynı başlık veya çok benzer içerik)
	WITH duplicate_titles AS (
	  SELECT 
	    title,
	    COUNT(*) as count,
	    STRING_AGG(id::text, ', ') as news_ids,
	    MIN(created_at) as first_published,
	    MAX(created_at) as last_published
	  FROM "News"
	  WHERE published = true
	  GROUP BY title
	  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
	),
	similar_content AS (
	  SELECT 
	    n1.id as news1_id,
	    n1.title as news1_title,
	    n1.created_at as news1_date,
	    n2.id as news2_id,
	    n2.title as news2_title,
	    n2.created_at as news2_date,
	    -- Başlık benzerliği (ilk 50 karakter)
	    CASE 
	      WHEN LOWER(SUBSTRING(n1.title, 1, 50)) = LOWER(SUBSTRING(n2.title, 1, 50)) THEN 'EXACT_MATCH'
	      WHEN LOWER(n1.title) LIKE '%' || LOWER(SUBSTRING(n2.title, 1, 30)) || '%' THEN 'SIMILAR'
	      ELSE 'DIFFERENT'
	    END as similarity
	  FROM "News" n1
	  CROSS JOIN "News" n2
	  WHERE n1.id < n2.id
	    AND n1.published = true
	    AND n2.published = true
	    AND (
	      -- Aynı başlık
	      LOWER(n1.title) = LOWER(n2.title)
	      OR
	      -- Başlık çok benzer (ilk 50 karakter)
	      LOWER(SUBSTRING(n1.title, 1, 50)) = LOWER(SUBSTRING(n2.title, 1, 50))
	    )
	  ORDER BY n1.created_at DESC
	  LIMIT 20
	)
	SELECT 
	  'DUPLICATE_TITLES' as check_type,
	  title,
	  count,
	  news_ids,
	  first_published,
	  last_published,
	  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (last_published - first_published))/3600 as hours_between
	FROM duplicate_titles
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
	  'SIMILAR_CONTENT' as check_type,
	  news1_title as title,
	  2 as count,
	  news1_id || ', ' || news2_id as news_ids,
	  news1_date as first_published,
	  news2_date as last_published,
	  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (news2_date - news1_date))/3600 as hours_between
	FROM similar_content
	ORDER BY last_published DESC;

	-- Duplicate veya çok benzer başlıklara sahip haberleri bul
	WITH article_pairs AS (
	  SELECT 
	    a1.id as article1_id,
	    a1.title as title1,
	    a1."publishedAt" as published1,
	    a2.id as article2_id,
	    a2.title as title2,
	    a2."publishedAt" as published2,
	    -- Başlık benzerliği (Levenshtein distance kullanarak)
	    similarity(a1.title, a2.title) as title_similarity,
	    -- Zaman farkı (saat cinsinden)
	    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a2."publishedAt" - a1."publishedAt")) / 3600 as hours_diff
	  FROM "Article" a1
	  CROSS JOIN "Article" a2
	  WHERE 
	    a1.id < a2.id  -- Her çifti sadece bir kez kontrol et
	    AND a1.status = 'PUBLISHED'
	    AND a2.status = 'PUBLISHED'
	    AND a1."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL
	    AND a2."publishedAt" IS NOT NULL
	    -- Son 7 gün içindeki haberler
	    AND a1."publishedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
	    AND a2."publishedAt" > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
	)
	SELECT 
	  article1_id,
	  title1,
	  published1,
	  article2_id,
	  title2,
	  published2,
	  ROUND(title_similarity::numeric, 3) as similarity_score,
	  ROUND(hours_diff::numeric, 2) as hours_between
	FROM article_pairs
	WHERE 
	  -- Yüksek benzerlik (0.7 = %70 benzer)
	  title_similarity > 0.7
	ORDER BY 
	  title_similarity DESC,
	  published1 DESC
	LIMIT 50;

	-- Oluşturulma Tarihi: 2025-01-01

	-- ============================================================================

	-- ============================================================================
	
	-- BatchType enum
	CREATE TYPE "BatchType" AS ENUM (
	  'MANUAL',
	  'SCHEDULED',

	  'RETRY',
	  'BULK_UPDATE'
	);
	
	-- BatchStatus enum
	CREATE TYPE "BatchStatus" AS ENUM (
	  'PENDING',
	  'QUEUED',
	  'PROCESSING',
	  'COMPLETED',
	  'FAILED',
	  'CANCELLED',
	  'PAUSED'
	);
	
	-- IndexType enum

	  'INDEXNOW',
	  'GOOGLE'
	);
	
	-- IndexAction enum
	CREATE TYPE "IndexAction" AS ENUM (
	  'SUBMIT',
	  'UPDATE',
	  'REMOVE'
	);
	
	-- IndexStatus enum'unu genişlet
	ALTER TYPE "IndexStatus" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'SCHEDULED';
	ALTER TYPE "IndexStatus" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'RATE_LIMITED';
	ALTER TYPE "IndexStatus" ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'SKIPPED';

	-- ============================================================================
	-- STEP 6: Mevcut Verileri Güncelle (Optional)
	-- ============================================================================
	
	-- Mevcut PENDING makaleleri için retry count'u sıfırla
	UPDATE "Article" 
	SET 
	  "indexNowRetryCount" = 0,
	  "googleIndexRetryCount" = 0
	WHERE 
	  "indexNowStatus" = 'PENDING' 
	  OR "googleIndexStatus" = 'PENDING';
	
	-- Mevcut FAILED makaleleri için retry zamanı ayarla (5 dakika sonra)
	UPDATE "Article" 
	SET 
	  "indexNowNextRetryAt" = NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
	WHERE 
	  "indexNowStatus" = 'FAILED' 
	  AND "indexNowRetryCount" < 3;
	
	UPDATE "Article" 
	SET 
	  "googleIndexNextRetryAt" = NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
	WHERE 
	  "googleIndexStatus" = 'FAILED' 
	  AND "googleIndexRetryCount" < 3;

	-- STEP 6: Mevcut Verileri Güncelle (Optional)

	-- Mevcut PENDING makaleleri için retry count'u sıfırla
	UPDATE "Article" 
	SET 
	  "indexNowRetryCount" = 0,
	  "googleIndexRetryCount" = 0
	WHERE 
	  "indexNowStatus" = 'PENDING' 
	  OR "googleIndexStatus" = 'PENDING';
	
	-- Mevcut FAILED makaleleri için retry zamanı ayarla (5 dakika sonra)
	UPDATE "Article" 
	SET 
	  "indexNowNextRetryAt" = NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
	WHERE 
	  "indexNowStatus" = 'FAILED' 
	  AND "indexNowRetryCount" < 3;
	
	UPDATE "Article" 
	SET 
	  "googleIndexNextRetryAt" = NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
	WHERE 
	  "googleIndexStatus" = 'FAILED' 
	  AND "googleIndexRetryCount" < 3;
